title: Hogan arrives and challenges Flair’s supremacy
summary: Hulk Hogan’s arrival changes WCW’s main-event hierarchy. Ric Flair fights to retain his place as champion, with their first chapter ending in a cage and a retirement stipulation.

chapters.title: Hogan wins his WCW debut
chapters.result: Hogan defeats Flair for the WCW World championship.
chapters.context: The established WCW champion loses the belt to the promotion’s major new arrival.

chapters.title: Flair loses the retirement cage match
chapters.result: Hogan defeats Flair in the title-versus-career cage match.
chapters.context: The result produces an on-screen retirement for Flair, who returns to wrestling the following year.
